subject: Taxes
title: Lost Wallets and Phantom Gains
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Lost Wallets and Phantom Gains.

hook.text: James Howells threw away a hard drive with 8,000 Bitcoin in 2013.

buildup.text: An estimated 3-4 million Bitcoin are lost forever: forgotten passwords, dead owners, corrupted drives.

discovery.text: The IRS has no official process for claiming a loss on inaccessible crypto.

twist.text: If you can't prove crypto is permanently lost, you can't deduct it. Proving a negative is nearly impossible.

climax.text: Lost crypto exists in tax limbo: the asset has value on paper.

punchline.text: Lost the password, kept the tax bill. Millions in crypto are stuck in limbo.

quiz.question: How many Bitcoin are estimated to be permanently lost?
